Pantheon of the Nile

Egyptian Gods and Goddesses Mood board

Sun & Creation The Osirian Family The Underworld Wisdom & Magic Love, Joy & Music The Fierce Protectresses Sky & Cosmos River & Abundance

Sun & Creation

The first light, and the ones who spoke, shaped, and rolled the world into being.

Ra

The Sun Itself

The great solar god who sails across the sky by day and battles through the underworld by night, reborn at every dawn.

Focus
Vitality, sovereignty, illumination
Powers
Life-giving light, kingship over gods and men, rebirth each morning
Look
Falcon or sun-disk crown, broad gold collar, white-and-gold kilt, sunburst cape.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Amun

The Hidden One

The invisible king of the gods, present in the wind and the breath, later merged with Ra as Amun-Ra.

Focus
Mystery, unseen influence, answered prayers
Powers
Invisibility, the moving air, hearing the humble when no one else does
Look
Tall double-plume crown, deep blue and gold, royal kilt and sceptre.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Atum

Lord of Totality

The self-created one who rose from the primeval waters and contains all that exists, beginning and end alike.

Focus
Wholeness, origins, completion
Powers
Self-creation from nothing; holds every ending inside himself
Look
The double crown of the Two Lands, white linen, serene gold jewellery.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Khepri

The Becoming One

The scarab-headed god of the rising sun, who rolls the dawn over the horizon the way a beetle rolls its ball.

Focus
Transformation, renewal, self-made beginnings
Powers
Regeneration out of nothing; pushing the sun into being every day
Look
Iridescent blues and greens, a scarab pectoral or headpiece, beetle-shell shimmer.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Ptah

The Craftsman Creator

The god who dreamed the world in his heart and then spoke it into existence, patron of builders, sculptors and artists.

Focus
Creation through word and craft, manifestation
Powers
Making real whatever is truly imagined and named
Look
Smooth blue skullcap, mummiform wrap or fitted robe, was-sceptre staff.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Khnum

The Divine Potter

The ram-headed god who shapes every human body and soul on his potter’s wheel, guardian of the Nile’s source.

Focus
Craftsmanship, formation, the source of things
Powers
Forms each person’s body and ka from clay; releases the inundation
Look
Curling ram horns, potter’s-earth tones, clay-dusted hands.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Aten

The Sun Disk

The radiant disk whose rays end in tiny hands, briefly worshipped as the one and only god under Akhenaten.

Focus
Universal light, oneness, reaching everything
Powers
Touches all beings at once with hands of light
Look
A radiant gold disc halo, minimalist white and gold, rays ending in little hands.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

The Osirian Family

The great myth at the heart of Egypt, a murder, a devotion, a resurrection, and a throne reclaimed.

Osiris

Lord of Rebirth

The green-skinned king who was murdered, reassembled and remade as lord of the underworld, god of death, rebirth and the growing grain.

Focus
Death and rebirth, cycles, the harvest
Powers
Resurrection, judgment of souls, making the seed rise again
Look
Green face paint, white mummiform wrap, tall atef crown, crook and flail crossed.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Isis

Great of Magic

The supreme mother and mightiest magician, who gathered her husband’s scattered pieces and loved him back to life.

Focus
Devotion, healing, magic, motherhood
Powers
The strongest heka of any god; knows Ra’s secret name; raises the dead
Look
Sweeping gold Isis wings, throne headdress, fitted sheath dress.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Horus

The Avenging Falcon

The falcon-headed sky god who fought his uncle Set for eighty years to reclaim his father’s throne.

Focus
Vision, rightful power, protection, kingship
Powers
His eyes are the sun and moon; sees everything from above; every pharaoh is his living image
Look
Gold falcon mask, blue-and-gold striped headdress, Eye of Horus makeup.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Set

Lord of Storms & the Red Desert

The god of chaos, storms and the desert, who murdered his brother, and yet stands at the prow of Ra’s boat each night to slay the serpent of oblivion.

Focus
Necessary disruption, raw strength, the outsider
Powers
Superhuman strength, command of storms, the only god fierce enough to face Apophis
Look
The strange square-eared Set-animal mask, storm reds and blacks, desert leather.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Nephthys

Lady of the Twilight

The quiet sister who stands at the edge of things, goddess of mourning, dusk and the sacred work of tending the dying.

Focus
Grief, endings, invisible service, thresholds
Powers
Protective lament; guides and guards the newly dead alongside Isis
Look
Twilight silvers and deep blues, veiled headdress, understated and elegant.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

The Underworld

The Duat, where hearts are weighed against a feather, ways are opened, and the sun itself must pass each night.

Taken

Anubis

Guide of Souls

The jackal-headed guardian of the dead, master embalmer and keeper of the scales where every heart is weighed.

Focus
Transitions, discernment, sacred passage
Powers
Weighs hearts against Ma’at’s feather; walks freely between worlds; protects the vulnerable dead
Look
Black jackal mask or ears, black bodywear with gold armour pieces and an ankh.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Ammit

Devourer of Hearts

Part crocodile, part lion, part hippopotamus, she waits beside the scales to swallow the hearts that fail the weighing.

Focus
Consequence, reckoning, finality
Powers
The second death, erasure from existence, from which there is no return
Look
Crocodile headpiece, leopard-print torso, a prop heart to snack on.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Wepwawet

Opener of the Ways

The wolf-headed scout who runs ahead of armies and souls alike, clearing the roads through battle and through death.

Focus
Pathfinding, first steps, going ahead
Powers
Opens every blocked way, on the battlefield, in the underworld, in the stuck places
Look
Grey-white wolf mask or ears, traveller’s cloak, a standard or staff.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Sokar

Falcon of the Deep Dark

The silent falcon god of the necropolis, dwelling in the deepest hour of night where transformation happens unseen.

Focus
Stillness, the fertile void, hidden metamorphosis
Powers
Master craftsman of the underworld; transmutes what rests in total darkness
Look
All-black falcon look, silver detailing, dark feathered cape.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Apophis

Serpent of Dissolution

The great serpent of un-creation who attacks the sun’s boat every single night, never worshipped, always fought, never finally defeated.

Focus
Chaos, entropy, the un-making of things
Powers
A gaze that hypnotises even gods; regenerates endlessly no matter how many times he is cut down
Look
Full serpent glamour, sequin scales, snake-eye makeup, hypnotic greens.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Aker

The Double Lion

Two lions seated back to back, one facing yesterday, one facing tomorrow, guarding the gates where the sun enters and leaves the earth.

Focus
Thresholds, liminal spaces, dawn and dusk
Powers
Guards the horizon gates; holds the passage between what was and what will be
Look
Golden lion mane worn double, pair up with a friend and face opposite ways.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Babi

Bull of the Baboons

The ferocious baboon god of raw virility and appetite, who feasts on the wicked in the underworld.

Focus
Raw instinct, untamed life-force
Powers
Ferocity no demon will face; commands the darkness with pure appetite
Look
Wild baboon mane, bared teeth, unapologetic red.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

The Four Sons of Horus

Guardians of the Vitals

Imsety, Hapy, Duamutef and Qebehsenuef, the four brothers who guard the organs of the dead through eternity, one jar each.

Focus
Preservation, loyalty, sacred teamwork
Powers
Keep what is essential safe forever; each holds one quarter of the work
Look
The ultimate group costume, human, baboon, jackal and falcon heads, matching jars.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Wisdom & Magic

The scribes, the measurers, and the force of magic itself, older than the gods who wield it.

Thoth

Scribe of the Gods

The ibis-headed god of wisdom who invented writing, keeps the moon’s time, and mediates every quarrel of the gods.

Focus
Knowledge, language, mediation, record-keeping
Powers
Words that bind reality; arbitration between warring gods; keeper of all knowledge
Look
Long-beaked ibis mask, lunar disc, scribe’s palette and reed pen.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Seshat

Mistress of the House of Books

The goddess of writing, measurement and memory, who stretches the cord to lay out every temple and records every deed.

Focus
Precision, memory, sacred architecture
Powers
Measures the foundations of temples; keeps the eternal record of every life
Look
Leopard-skin dress, seven-pointed star headband, scrolls tucked in the belt.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Ma’at

Truth as a Goddess

The goddess of truth, balance and cosmic order, whose single ostrich feather outweighs every unquiet heart.

Focus
Balance, integrity, cosmic order, justice
Powers
She is the order the universe runs on; her feather is the measure of every soul
Look
White goddess dress, one great ostrich feather upright in the headband, feathered wings.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Heka

Magic Itself

Not a god who uses magic but the personification of magic, the power that existed before creation and makes all miracles possible.

Focus
Creative force, the word made real, potency
Powers
Activates every spell ever cast, by gods or mortals; older than the universe
Look
Sorcerer’s robes, a twin-serpent staff, amulets layered deep.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Khonsu

The Wanderer

The youthful moon god and traveller of the night sky, who once gambled hours of his own moonlight in a game of senet, and lost.

Focus
Time, cycles, youth, the night journey
Powers
Marks and bends time; drives out demons of sickness; lights the traveller’s road
Look
Crescent-and-full-moon crown, the side-lock of youth, silvery blues.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Love, Joy & Music

The gods of the sistrum and the dance floor, pleasure, beauty and holy celebration.

Hathor

The Golden One

The cow-horned goddess of love, music, dance and sacred intoxication, who welcomes both newborns and the newly dead.

Focus
Pleasure, beauty, celebration, sensual joy
Powers
Joy as a cosmic force; the mirror and the sistrum; turns grief into dancing
Look
Cow horns cradling a sun disc, red or gold dress, sistrum in hand, mirror at hip.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗
Taken

Bastet

Lady of the Cats

The cat goddess of home, music and feminine grace, gentle by the hearth and lethal to whatever threatens it.

Focus
Playfulness, sensual grace, hearth and home
Powers
Fierce protection wrapped in elegance; wards off evil spirits and disease
Look
Sleek black cat ears or mask, gold collar and hoops, winged eyeliner for days.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Bes

The Sacred Fool

The dancing dwarf god who pulls grotesque faces to frighten demons from the doorway, beloved protector of mothers, children and sleep.

Focus
Joy as protection, humour, the household
Powers
Laughter that banishes evil; guards birth-beds and dreams
Look
Leopard skin, tall feather crown, wild mane and beard, tambourine.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Min

Lord of the Eastern Desert

The unabashed fertility god of desire, harvest and the life-force that makes everything grow.

Focus
Virility, desire, generativity, abundance
Powers
Fertility of fields, herds and people; the raw current of creation
Look
Twin-plume crown, black and gold, a flail held high, lettuce optional (truly his sacred plant).
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Nefertem

The Blue Lotus

The beautiful god of the first lotus, which rose from the dark primeval waters and opened to release the sun, lord of perfume and healing.

Focus
Beauty rising from mud, fragrance, healing
Powers
Healing through scent and beauty; the daily miracle of opening
Look
A blue lotus headpiece, water-lily blues and golds, a trail of perfume.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

The Fierce Protectresses

Lionesses, cobras, scorpions and vultures, the terrifying faces of love that guards.

Sekhmet

The Powerful One

The lioness goddess of war and medicine, whose breath is the desert wind and who once nearly destroyed humanity until she was tricked with beer dyed red as blood.

Focus
Righteous rage, fierce healing, purification
Powers
Both plague and its cure; destruction that clears the ground for healing
Look
Lioness mask or mane, blood-red sheath dress, gold sun disc.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Neith

The First Weaver

Perhaps the oldest deity of all, huntress, weaver and self-created mother, who re-weaves the world on her loom each day and whose word settles disputes among gods.

Focus
Self-sufficiency, strategy, creation by craft
Powers
Arrows that never miss; the loom on which reality is woven; wisdom even Ra defers to
Look
The red crown of the north, bow and crossed arrows, woven shawl.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Serqet

She Who Causes the Throat to Breathe

The scorpion goddess who governs venom in both directions, the sting and its cure, guardian of the vulnerable living and dead.

Focus
Poison as medicine, protection, breath
Powers
Heals stings and bites; what she protects, nothing venomous can touch
Look
A golden scorpion poised on the crown, sleek gold sheath, sharp jewellery.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Wadjet

The Rearing Cobra

The cobra goddess of Lower Egypt who rears on the pharaoh’s brow as the uraeus, spitting fire at the crown’s enemies.

Focus
Sovereignty, fierce protection, royal authority
Powers
Flame from her mouth; the strike no enemy sees coming
Look
Rearing cobra crown (the uraeus), serpent-green and gold, papyrus sceptre.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Nekhbet

The White Vulture

The vulture mother of Upper Egypt whose wings spread over the pharaoh, goddess of protection who knows death and renewal intimately.

Focus
Maternal guardianship, patience, the long view
Powers
Wings that shelter kings; sees what is ending and what is beginning
Look
White vulture headdress, sweeping white-feather cloak or wings.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Taweret

The Great Female

The upright hippopotamus goddess with a lion’s paws and a crocodile’s back, terrifying to demons and tender to every labouring mother.

Focus
Protection of new life, birth, fierce tenderness
Powers
Scares off everything that threatens mothers and infants
Look
Hippo snout headpiece if you dare, lion paws, a round proud belly.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Mut

Queen of Heaven

The great mother goddess of Thebes, wearer of the double crown and the vulture headdress, consort of Amun and mother of the divine order.

Focus
Motherhood, queenship, dynasty
Powers
The primal mother from whom order descends; royal legitimacy itself
Look
Vulture crown topped with the double crown, full queenly gown, regal gold.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Sky & Cosmos

The arched sky, the earth beneath her, and the air that holds them forever apart.

Nut

The Star-Covered Sky

The sky herself, a woman arched over the whole world, her body scattered with stars, who swallows the sun each evening and gives birth to it each dawn.

Focus
The great container, night, stars, holding everything
Powers
Swallows and rebirths the sun daily; mother of Osiris, Isis, Set and Nephthys
Look
Midnight-blue bodysuit or gown scattered with gold stars, become the night sky.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Geb

The Earth

The earth god lying beneath the sky, whose laughter is the earthquake and from whose back all green things grow, forever reaching for Nut above him.

Focus
Grounding, fertility, the body of the land
Powers
All abundance rises from him; his mirth shakes mountains
Look
Earth tones, green body paint, leaves and grasses, a goose somewhere on your person.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Shu

God of Air & Light

The god of the air and the space between, who stands on the earth and holds the sky aloft on his upraised arms, forever.

Focus
Breath, space, boundaries, holding the middle
Powers
Every breath is his; the space that makes life possible at all
Look
Airy whites, a single tall ostrich feather crown, arms forever raised.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Tefnut

Lady of Moisture

The lioness goddess of moisture, dew and rain, who once stormed off to Nubia in a fury, and the whole world dried up until she was coaxed home.

Focus
Nourishment, emotional weather, softening
Powers
Brings the rain and dew; her mood is the world’s climate
Look
Lioness features with rain-and-dew shimmer, mist blues over gold.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Sopdet

The Sharp Star

The goddess of Sirius, whose rising before dawn after seventy days of absence announced the flood and the new year.

Focus
Cosmic timing, new beginnings, promise
Powers
Heralds the inundation; the star the whole calendar turns on
Look
A five-pointed star blazing on the crown, deep-space blue and silver.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

River & Abundance

The flood that fed a civilisation, and the gods of everything it carried, harvest, birth and what waits below the surface.

Hapi

Spirit of the Inundation

The generous, full-bellied god of the Nile flood, whose annual arrival turned the desert’s edge into the richest farmland on earth.

Focus
Abundance, generosity, the returning gift
Powers
The inundation itself, the wealth of Egypt arriving on schedule
Look
Nile blues and greens, lotus and papyrus garlands, a generously painted belly.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Sobek

Lord of the Waters

The crocodile god of the river, primal, patient and immensely strong, worshipped as both protector and the danger itself.

Focus
Primal power, patience, survival
Powers
The strength of the Nile in one body; guards the just, ambushes the rest
Look
Crocodile head or textured croc-skin greens, Nile jewellery, still and watchful.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Renenutet

Lady of the Harvest

The cobra goddess of nourishment and the granary, who whispers each newborn’s secret name and with it their fortune.

Focus
Nourishment, naming, destiny, plenty
Powers
Blesses the harvest; gives every child its true name and fate
Look
Cobra hood, harvest golds, wheat woven into the crown.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Heqet

The Frog of the Final Hour

The frog-headed goddess of the last moment of birth, who breathes life into the body just before it enters the world.

Focus
Last-stage becoming, quickening, midwifery
Powers
The final breath of life into every new thing being born
Look
Frog-green shimmer, a small frog crown, midwife’s white linen.
Pinterest↗Etsy↗

Every god here was painted in the same six pigments, gold, lapis, turquoise, ochre, black and white. Wear your chosen one’s colours boldly, the bolder the better.
